description: An exclusive gazebo with a pergola — from 3D visualization to construction on site. Garden architecture by DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
h1: Gazebo with pergola: design and construction

blocks.text: Gazebo with pergola: design and construction

parts.html: A gazebo with a pergola on the grounds of a private house. The studio developed the architectural concept and proportions, chose the finishing materials, and planned a seating area and decorative evening lighting. The gazebo was designed together with the architecture of the house, and the finishes were chosen to stand up to the weather. It was built to the design: the page starts with the 3D visualizations, followed by photos from the construction site.

The gazebo is enclosed, with a glazed front. Sliding panoramic doors open onto the garden, with a wooden deck in front of them. The walls are finished in light textured plaster divided by dark brown trim strips, and the roof is covered with metal tiles in a matching color.

The pergola is attached to the end wall. Its frame of metal posts and beams is the same brown, and a screen of horizontal slats on one side shields the seating area from wind and the neighbors’ view. The design puts a summer kitchen under the pergola: a concrete countertop and a grill area with an extractor hood. On the other side of the deck hangs a cocoon chair.

Inside is a single room: a long solid wood dining table and a kitchen along the blank wall. The lower fronts are gray with vertical fluting, while the upper cabinets and the TV wall are finished in veneer. The piers between the windows are clad in dark stone-effect tiles, and the floor is laid with large light tiles bordered by a dark band. Two chandeliers made of glass tubes hang above the table, with recessed spotlights in the ceiling.

The accent walls are built from wooden slats of different lengths. Between them run vertical backlit moss inserts, and one of these walls hides a trimless door. The bathroom has a wall-hung toilet, glass shelves in a niche, a vessel basin on a white countertop, and a wall of tiles with a graphic pattern.

The construction photos show that the pergola frame, slatted screen, glazing and facade finishes were built as designed. More of the studio’s work on separate structures and facades is collected in the architecture and design section.
